title: Mobs Devolve
description: Mobs devolve into weaker mobs when killed, with trigger function to change multiplier.
body:
This is a challenge datapack to spawn an amount of mobs when another mob is killed. Currently it supports:

Ender Dragon
Wither
Enderman
Witch
Creeper
Skeleton
Zombie
Spider
Silverfish

When a mob on this list is killed it will spawn a number of the mob below it on the list, set by the [/trigger setmult set <amount>] command. Default is 1.

[Here is a video of it in action.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4q2ZCiGXqWA)
